title: tc-agent-graph
description: Agents and the tools they use, drawn as a living network with pulses along the links.

nodes.description: The agents, tools and people in the graph – the lead agent in the middle, the other agents around it, the rest outside

calls.description: Recent calls, newest last – every new id sends a pulse. Calls also draw the links they need

edges.description: Links that are always there, even before their first call

now.description: The clock for calls per minute and link heat, in epoch ms – defaults to an internal clock that ticks every second while the graph is on screen

heatWindow.description: How far back calls make a link thicker (ms)

selected.description: The node whose card is open (null = none). Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

height.description: Fixed height of the graph in px – defaults to one that fits the width

paused.description: Stops the moving parts, as the bar's Pause button does. Changed by the user unless a tc-paused-change listener calls preventDefault()

heading.description: The heading in the bar, and the start of the graph's name

kind.description: "agent" sits on the inner orbit (the lead in the middle), "tool" and "user" on the outer one

short.description: A shorter name for narrow containers, e.g. "Search" for "Web search"

detail.description: One line under the name – the model of an agent, what a tool is

doing.description: What it is doing right now – shown in its card

cost.description: What it has cost so far – summed up in the bar

lead.description: The agent in the middle – defaults to the first agent

to.description: … and who is called – a tool, another agent, or you

label.description: What was asked, e.g. "search: pricing linear.app"

status.description: "pending" sends the pulse out; once it turns "ok" or "error" the answer travels back
